select 
  sum(case when b.`name` in ('自有品牌F6', '自有品牌B2', '自有品牌A1', '自有品牌E5', '自有品牌C3', '自有品牌D4') then s.`sales_amount` else 0 end) as `own_brand_sales_amount`,
  sum(case when b.`name` not in ('自有品牌F6', '自有品牌B2', '自有品牌A1', '自有品牌E5', '自有品牌C3', '自有品牌D4') then s.`sales_amount` else 0 end) as `non_own_brand_sales_amount`
from `trd_daily_sku_sales` s
join `prd_sku` sk on s.`sku_id` = sk.`id`
join `prd_spu` sp on sk.`spu_id` = sp.`id`
join `prd_brand` b on sp.`brand_id` = b.`id`
where s.`stat_date` >= '2026-02-01' and s.`stat_date` < '2026-03-01';
